# Full-Stack Security Testing Agent Skill

Install this folder at:

`.github/skills/fullstack-security-testing/`

The main file is `SKILL.md`.

In VS Code Copilot Chat, invoke:

`/fullstack-security-testing`

Or ask Copilot in Agent mode:

`Run the full-stack security testing skill against my local React/Node/MongoDB application and generate the report.`

The skill is intentionally instructions-driven: Copilot discovers your actual routes, scripts, authentication model, and existing tests before creating/running tests.

Reports are written under:

`test-results/`
